name: Raynewood Retreat
summary: Raynewood Retreat watches the northern approaches to Felwood from a great tree in Ashenvale. Dryads and Cenarion protectors guard the outpost, where Keeper Ordanus makes his home.

sections.title: Bastion of the Great Tree
sections.body: At Raynewood Retreat, the great tree rises between Shael'dryn's moonwell and the satyr-infested ruins of Night Run. Cenarion Protectors, faerie dragons, and Laughing Sisters guard the outpost. Their watch turns north, toward the taint spreading from Felwood.

sections.title: The Hunt for Ordanus
sections.body: Keeper Ordanus lives high among the great tree's boughs, one of Cenarius's eldest sons. The canopy shelters him, yet it has drawn the attention of dark forces. Agents tied to the Shadow Council's remnants, including Braelyn Firehand, seek his death. Horde mercenaries are sent to storm the heights and claim his head, bringing battle to the forest sanctuary.

faq.answer: Raynewood Retreat watches the approaches to Felwood from a night elf and Cenarion settlement around a Great Tree in north-central Ashenvale. The Alliance-aligned outpost guards the northern passes.
Cenarion Protectors, Laughing Sisters, and faerie dragons defend Raynewood Retreat. Keeper Ordanus lives high in the great tree.
Keeper Ordanus is a keeper of the grove and one of Cenarius's eldest sons. He oversees the sanctuary.

faq.q: Why does the Horde attack Raynewood Retreat?
faq.answer: Braelyn Firehand hires Horde adventurers to enter the tree and seek Keeper Ordanus. Her motives and allegiances come to light through the events there.

angles.text: As a druid, you find holy ground at Raynewood Retreat, under the care of Cenarius's children. The grove guards against demonic and fel corruption.
As a member of the Horde, you face an Alliance-friendly grove at Raynewood Retreat. Its guardian, Keeper Ordanus, is marked for elimination by covert employers.
